lessons_learned.title: Midnight 00:00 UTC Funding Rate Shakeout
lessons_learned.insight: High-leverage altcoins experience violent stop-hunt wicks during 00:00 UTC daily close and funding settlement (Audit: SUIUSDT 22-Apr-2026). Guardrail: Disqualify entries within 10 minutes of 00:00 UTC.

lessons_learned.title: Macro Bitcoin Flash Dump Override
lessons_learned.insight: Altcoin order blocks cannot withstand BTC 1H/4H flash dump > -2.0% (Audit: ARBUSDT 11-Nov-2025). Guardrail: Pause altcoin BUY entries when King Bitcoin drops > -1.5% in 1H.

lessons_learned.title: 1st OB Overhead Airspace Rejection vs CVD Blasting
lessons_learned.insight: Option B airspace filter eliminated 24 winning trades because institutional CVD delta surges blast right through 1st OB ceilings. Strategy Rule: Rely on CVD delta reversal rather than rigid airspace gaps.
